42972.question_text: A projectile fired with initial velocity, u will attain its maximum height H when the angle of projection θ is
42972.explanation:
The maximum height (H) of a projectile is given by:

\(H=\frac{u^2\sin^2\theta}{2g}\)

Since (u) (initial velocity) and (g) (acceleration due to gravity) are fixed, the maximum height depends on \(\sin^2\theta\).

The largest value of \(\sin\theta\) is 1, which occurs when:
